title: Atlassian Rovo MCP: Manage capacity planning settings
description:
Administrators can now manage how users interact with Individual Capacity planning content through Rovo MCP in Atlassian Administration. This update introduces new controls to specify whether managed users can view, create, or edit their capacity planning data using a Model Context Protocol (MCP) connection. Go to admin.atlassian.com.
	Select your organization if you have more than one.
	Go to Settings, then Rovo.
	Select Rovo MCP Server and then Permissions.
